title: SEAL: Systematic Error Analysis for Value ALignment

bias_targets.methodology: The paper uses an LLM (GPT-4) to label entries in an alignment dataset as 'discriminatory' based on a taxonomy including race, color, sex, national origin, gender, religious discrimination, sexual orientation, political belief, disability, age, and status as a parent. It then performs regression analysis (feature imprint) to measure whether the reward model rewards or penalizes content containing these discriminatory features.
